title: Sharpe Ratio Inference after Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.29747v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The economic value of return signals is often assessed using the Sharpe ratios of portfolios based on those signals. In modern asset pricing, return signals often depend on many features, including state variables and firm-specific characteristics, and machine-learning methods are increasingly used to estimate them. But how much confidence can we place in the estimated Sharpe ratios? We find that signal-estimation error can remain consequential for inference even in large asset panels. Moreover, pooling observations across assets does not necessarily make this uncertainty negligible when predictors contain common features or exhibit substantial cross-sectional dependence. As a remedy, we develop a debiased Sharpe-ratio estimator that accounts for signal-estimation error and provides valid confidence intervals and tests against benchmarks. translated_title: 机器学习之后的夏普比率推断
translated_abstract: 收益信号的经济价值通常通过基于这些信号构建的投资组合的夏普比率来评估。在现代资产定价中，收益信号往往依赖于众多特征，包括状态变量和公司特定特征，而机器学习方法正被越来越多地用于估计这些信号。但我们对估计出的夏普比率能有多大信心？我们发现，即使在大规模资产面板中，信号估计误差对统计推断的影响仍然可能十分显著。此外，当预测变量包含共同特征或呈现显著的横截面相关性时，跨资产合并观测并不一定能将这种不确定性降低到可忽略的程度。作为解决方案，我们开发了一个去偏夏普比率估计量，该估计量充分考虑了信号估计误差，并提供有效的置信区间以及针对基准的假设检验。我们的目标是在真实条件下评估特定投资组合规则的总体夏普比率。
tldr: 该论文揭示了机器学习信号估计误差会使夏普比率的推断产生偏差，并提出了一种去偏夏普比率估计量，可在共同特征与横截面相关存在的情况下提供有效的置信区间和假设检验。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a debiased Sharpe-ratio estimator that accounts for machine-learning signal-estimation error, providing valid confidence intervals and tests even when predictors contain common features or exhibit substantial cross-sectional dependence.
